title: Modular RPG Characters
author: System G6 / Qoma
modifications: Rebuilt Principled materials from upstream PNG atlases; PNG pixels unchanged
Bound modular hair and clothing to existing 43-bone armature using upstream weights
Retained five motion clips and exported embedded GLB
accessories: Original Mythwood bow, cape, scarf, quiver and braid geometry in ranger-skinned.js
status: Provisional base, not final approved Daria sculpt; no purchase

refined.derived_from: Same System G6 CC0 human_female.blend archive documented above
original_geometry: Fitted open-front expedition jacket and lapels
Leather harness, seams, belt and map notebook
Swept hair cap, directional locks and three-strand braid
changes_to_base: Selected anatomical body instead of medium armor
Head topology subdivided once, lower face mildly narrowed/elongated; original facial texture retained
Clothing modules weighted to the original skeleton
refined.runtime_changes: Folded shorter cape, fabric data maps and refined/base comparison; no raster pixels edited
refined.status: Local visual trial; owner judged result far below target. Further art work paused in favor of gameplay/content. Both versions retained.

pass01.derived_from: daria-refined.glb in this folder (same System G6 CC0 anatomy, skeleton and five clips; the upstream archive is not required)
original_geometry: Jacket, sleeves, tunic and trousers as offset shells of the body, with body skin weights
Jacket skirt removed after combat measurement (panels entered the thighs while running)
Ragged terracotta capelet with brass ring brooch
Hair volume sampled on the skull, side waves, crown strands and three-strand braid over the left shoulder
Bracers, belts, thigh straps (no rigid buckles), quiver strap, quiver with six arrows, pouch and map notebook
original_pixels: Face texture repainted procedurally at 2048 px, anti-aliased, no blur (skin, freckles, hazel-green eyes with limbal ring, lids, brows, lips) on the upstream UV layout; no upstream face pixels kept
Fabric and leather textures generated procedurally
changes_to_base: Body faces covered by clothing removed (no skin can poke through)
Head mildly narrowed in the lower face, jaw widened
Boots and their upstream texture retained
pass01.status: Character-art pass 01: closer to the approved sheet, not a final sculpt; see docs/art/DARIA_PASS_01.md
